media.alt: IGHD Participates in the European Union Climate Conference

content.text: Dr. Jai Das, Assistant Director at the Institute for Global Health and Development (IGHD), recently participated as a speaker at the esteemed conference on Research Perspectives on the Health Impacts of Climate Change, hosted by the Directorate-General for Research and Innovation of the European Commission (DG RTD).

Dr. Das was invited to participate as a panelist in the parallel session titled 'Extreme Weather Events and Physical and Mental Health.' This session delved into the profound impacts of extreme weather events on both physical and mental health, exploring strategies for adaptation and mitigation.

This invitation underscores Dr. Das's expertise and leadership in the field of global health, particularly in addressing the complex interplay between climate change and human health. His extensive experience in researching and advocating for solutions to mitigate the health impacts of environmental change positions him as a key voice in this critical discourse. His participation at such a prestigious platform not only highlights his individual contributions but also reflects IGHD's overarching commitment to fostering interdisciplinary collaboration and driving impactful change in global health initiatives.
